description: Year-end check of which payees need a Form 1099-NEC or 1099-MISC. Send the payment year (2020 to 2026) and each payment you made in that year: your own payee code, the payee type (individual or sole proprietor, partnership or multi-member LLC, corporation, government or tax-exempt, foreign person, employee), what it was for (services, legal fees, rent, medical and health care, goods), how you paid (check, bank transfer, cash, card, third-party network such as PayPal) and the amount. Get back, per payee, the amount that counts, the threshold for that year ($600 up to 2025, $2,000 for 2026), whether to file and which form and box, why not when not, a backup-withholding flag when no W-9 is on file, and the due dates (recipient copy, IRS paper, IRS electronic) with weekend shifts, plus whether e-filing is required. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/1099-filing-check). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

label.description: Optional label for the run (your own text, echoed back; not a person).

payment_year.description: Calendar year the payments were made (2020 to 2026). Later years need the inflation-adjusted threshold, which is not published yet.

payments.description: Every payment made in that year (up to 200 lines; add up bigger sets per payee, method and kind first).

amount.description: Amount paid in the year, in dollars.

kind.description: What the payment was for. Fees to a lawyer for legal services = legal_fees; goods bought for resale or use = goods_or_merchandise.

method.description: How you paid. Card and third-party network (PayPal, Venmo, Stripe...) payments are reported by the processor on Form 1099-K, not by you.

payee.description: Your own code for the payee (vendor number such as V-100). Never a name, tax ID or account number.

payee_type.description: Payee type from the W-9 or your records. 'corporation' includes an LLC taxed as a corporation and S corporations. A one-person LLC is the individual unless it elected corporation tax.

w9_on_file.description: Optional: true if you hold a signed W-9 (with the tax ID) for this payee. Send the fact, never the tax ID.
